# Lab 14.13: Create a PSC Endpoint for Google APIs

## What We Are Going to Do
Create a Private Service Connect endpoint with your own internal IP for Google APIs, and call Cloud Storage through it.

## Steps

1. **Enable APIs and create a network.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud services enable dns.googleapis.com servicedirectory.googleapis.com
gcloud compute networks create psc-vpc --subnet-mode=custom
gcloud compute networks subnets create psc-subnet --network=psc-vpc \
  --region=us-central1 --range=10.70.0.0/24 --enable-private-ip-google-access
gcloud compute firewall-rules create psc-iap --network=psc-vpc --allow=tcp:22 \
  --source-ranges=35.235.240.0/20</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **Reserve an internal IP for the endpoint.** It must be outside your subnets.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute addresses create psc-apis-ip --global \
  --purpose=PRIVATE_SERVICE_CONNECT \
  --addresses=10.100.0.10 \
  --network=psc-vpc</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **Create the endpoint.** The name must be short, lowercase letters and numbers only.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute forwarding-rules create pscapis --global \
  --network=psc-vpc \
  --address=psc-apis-ip \
  --target-google-apis-bundle=all-apis</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Use `vpc-sc` instead of `all-apis` to reach only APIs supported by VPC Service Controls.

4. **Check DNS.** A private zone for `p.googleapis.com` is created for you.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute instances create psc-vm --zone=us-central1-a --machine-type=e2-micro \
  --subnet=psc-subnet --no-address --scopes=cloud-platform
gcloud compute ssh psc-vm --zone=us-central1-a --tunnel-through-iap \
  --command="getent hosts storage-pscapis.p.googleapis.com"</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   It resolves to `10.100.0.10`.

5. **Call Cloud Storage through the endpoint.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute ssh psc-vm --zone=us-central1-a --tunnel-through-iap --command='
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $(gcloud auth print-access-token)" \
  "https://storage-pscapis.p.googleapis.com/storage/v1/b?project=YOUR_PROJECT_ID" | head -20'</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


6. **Clean up.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute instances delete psc-vm --zone=us-central1-a --quiet
gcloud compute forwarding-rules delete pscapis --global --quiet
gcloud compute addresses delete psc-apis-ip --global --quiet
gcloud compute firewall-rules delete psc-iap --quiet
gcloud compute networks subnets delete psc-subnet --region=us-central1 --quiet
gcloud compute networks delete psc-vpc --quiet</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Endpoint IP | Your own internal address |
| DNS name | `SERVICE-ENDPOINT.p.googleapis.com` |
| Bundles | `all-apis` or `vpc-sc` |
| Reachable from | VPC, and on-premises over VPN or Interconnect |
